title: gentianella sturmiana
intro: Gentianella sturmiana, commonly known as Alpine gentian, is a low-growing, perennial plant species in the gentian family, native to high-altitude mountainous regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits that include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella sturmiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective properties. The iridoids, specifically gentiopicroside, are particularly recognized for their ability to stimulate digestion, improve liver function, and enhance immune response.
